platforms.observed_design: short path lessons; progressive recognition→typing; personalized mistake review; streaks; listening/speaking in supported courses
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Add optional 5–10 minute path, but couple every unit to open production and Hindi can-do test

platforms.observed_design: bite-size structured lessons, explicit grammar, dialogues, review; live offering varies by language
platforms.scope_or_limitation: Hindi is not a current core Babbel language; product pattern is transferable, not Hindi evidence
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Use concise just-in-time grammar cards and dialogue-first sequencing
evidence_ids: market product pages; platform availability must be rechecked

platforms.observed_design: CEFR-visible paths, study plans, grammar/vocab review, community corrections, offline and certificates in selected languages
platforms.strength: goal clarity plus social feedback loop
platforms.scope_or_limitation: Hindi availability/depth and certificate scope cannot be assumed
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Can-do dashboard + moderated Hindi feedback; call EkGuru certificate a completion credential unless externally validated

platforms.observed_design: short native-speaker clips, vocabulary review, scenario/AI features in supported courses
platforms.strength: speaker variability and memorable contextual vocabulary
platforms.scope_or_limitation: grammar/extended writing and Hindi advanced depth are not established by reviewed evidence
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Attach 2–4 real-speaker variants to high-value chunks and route them into sentence SRS
evidence_ids: product/review evidence; verify Hindi catalogue at implementation

platforms.observed_design: conversation-based chunks, literal/understood meanings and pattern highlighting
platforms.strength: makes form-function patterns visible inside practical dialogue
platforms.scope_or_limitation: depth differs by language; no evidence here of Hindi C1–C2
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Dual gloss (literal/natural), colour-coded morphology, then generative roleplay

platforms.observed_design: ~30-minute audio anticipation and graduated interval recall
platforms.strength: forces oral recall without screen and builds response readiness
platforms.scope_or_limitation: Hindi offering is limited compared with six-level CEFR blueprint; literacy cannot be inferred
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Hands-free audio track paired with optional transcript and separate Devanagari lab

platforms.observed_design: interactive audio, play-a-role, record/ASR, language/culture and reinforcement drills
platforms.strength: integrated dialogue rehearsal and pronunciation attempts
platforms.scope_or_limitation: available Hindi depth is generally beginner/intermediate; ASR is not communicative assessment
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Branching Play-the-Part with intelligibility score plus meaning/interaction rubric

platforms.observed_design: micro-lessons, script/phonetics, audio, grammar, dialogue and gamified practice
platforms.scope_or_limitation: all-level marketing does not demonstrate C1/C2 productive outcomes
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Retain approachable UI but publish level outcome map and evidence portfolio

platforms.observed_design: audio thinking method and guided learner reasoning; free/open access
platforms.strength: elicits grammar patterns rather than passive explanation
platforms.scope_or_limitation: no complete Hindi course confirmed; audio format lacks full literacy/assessment
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Create “Hindi thinking” discovery tracks as supplements, never the full pathway

platforms.observed_design: user-controlled multimedia cards and modern FSRS scheduling
platforms.strength: powerful individualized retrieval with transparent control
platforms.scope_or_limitation: content quality depends on author; not a curriculum or skill assessment
platforms.ekguru_adaptation: Curated card eligibility, FSRS telemetry, leech repair and course-linked source IDs

platforms.observed_design: frequency-banded sentence cloze, SRS and listening modes
platforms.scope_or_limitation: sentence quality/context and free production need separate safeguards

platforms.observed_design: native-recorded sentences, listen/repeat/type/record and personalized SRS
platforms.scope_or_limitation: can be repetitive; recording may not correct pronunciation; non-Latin typing burden

platforms.strength: choice of teacher, conversation and feedback
